description: This file implements the Hibernate-specific Data Access Object (DAO) for Encounter entities within the OpenMRS medical record system. It provides methods to create, retrieve, update, and delete Encounter-related data, including searching by various criteria such as patient, encounter type, visit, and other properties. The class handles complex query constructions using the Criteria API and manages Hibernate sessions for database interactions.

classes.name: HibernateEncounterDAO
classes.description: Hibernate implementation of the EncounterDAO interface, providing database operations for Encounter entities using JPA Criteria API and Hibernate Session management.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory to be used for database interactions.

methods.name: saveEncounter
methods.description: Saves or updates an Encounter entity in the database.

methods.name: deleteEncounter
methods.description: Deletes an Encounter entity from the database.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves an Encounter by its ID.

methods.name: getEncountersByPatientId
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided encounters for a specific patient, ordered by encounter date descending.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Fetches encounters based on comprehensive search criteria encapsulated in EncounterSearchCriteria.

methods.name: saveEncounterType
methods.description: Saves or updates an EncounterType entity.

methods.name: deleteEncounterType
methods.description: Deletes an EncounterType entity.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType by its ID.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType by its name.

methods.name: getAllEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns all encounter types, optionally including retired ones, ordered by name.

methods.name: findEncounterTypes
methods.description: Finds encounter types matching a name pattern, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getSavedEncounterDatetime
methods.description: Fetches the datetime of an encounter directly from the database, bypassing the Hibernate cache.

methods.name: getEncounterByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an Encounter entity based on its UUID.

methods.name: getEncounterTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType based on its UUID.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves encounters matching a string query, patient ID, start, and length, with optional filtering for voided encounters.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisit
methods.description: Gets encounters associated with a specific visit, optionally including voided encounters.

methods.name: saveEncounterRole
methods.description: Saves or updates an EncounterRole entity.

methods.name: deleteEncounterRole
methods.description: Deletes an EncounterRole entity.

methods.name: getEncounterRole
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterRole by ID.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterRole by UUID.

methods.name: getAllEncounterRoles
methods.description: Fetches all EncounterRoles, with an option to include or exclude retired ones.

methods.name: getEncounterRoleByName
methods.description: Fetches an EncounterRole by its name.

methods.name: getEncountersNotAssignedToAnyVisit
methods.description: Gets recent encounters for a patient that are not linked to any visit.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatient
methods.description: Retrieves encounters related to a patient, with options for filtering by visit, query, and including voided enounters.

methods.name: getEncountersByVisitsAndPatientCount
methods.description: Counts encounters and visits for a patient matching search criteria.
